hero.heading: Agricultural Institute of
hero.description: GreenRoot is an agricultural institute and student internship platform working for agriculture students and farmers. We provide world-class training through experienced teaching staff and practical international internship programmes in dairy farming, poultry, horticulture, and field crops.

images.mainAlt: GreenRoot students at an international agricultural training programme
images.secondaryAlt: Hands-on dairy and cooperative farming training

story.heading: From Ex-AGRICOS to empowering the next generation of agri-professionals.
story.description: We started working in 2019. Ex-AGRICOS founded what is now GreenRoot as an institution for current AGRICOS (Agriculture College Students). The GreenRoot name reflects our mission to grow towards agriculture — India is world famous when it comes to culture and agriculture. From the beginning, we focused on agriculture students, agricultural entrepreneurs, and farmers.

chapters.title: Our Mission
chapters.label: Mission
chapters.body: To provide agricultural students with the world's best internship and training platforms that transform their lives through international work experience, high-quality farming and modern production operations, and skill development that develops them as Agri-Entrepreneurs. To connect Indian farmers and agriculture students to the world's best agricultural technologies and professionals.

chapters.title: Our Vision
chapters.label: Vision
chapters.body: To be India's best platform for International Internship and Training that partners with governmental and commercial entities in realising agriculture development all over the world and achieving long-term growth of agricultural students and farmers.

chapters.title: Our Roots
chapters.label: Since 2019
chapters.body: GreenRoot has conducted seminars for farmers and young professionals in agriculture, and designed special programmes to encourage new entrepreneurs in the sector. Through our Agri Professional Development Program, students get the opportunity to intern and train abroad for one year — with more than 100 students already placed in dairy, poultry, horticulture, and field crops across different countries.

pillars.heading: Integrity, transparency & service excellence
pillars.description: Three core values that guide every programme, partnership, and student placement.

items.title: Integrity
items.text: Building trust with customers, communities, suppliers, and one another by doing what is right.

items.title: Transparency
items.text: Ensuring openness, communication, and accountability in all our engagements with students, partners, and farmers.

items.title: Service Excellence
items.text: Building an organisational culture based on service and operational excellence in thought and in execution.

team.heading: The People Behind GreenRoot
team.description: Founded and led by agriculture professionals committed to connecting Indian students with global opportunities.

goals.heading: Programmes & Services
goals.description: Tailored internship and training programmes designed to make agriculture students self-sufficient and career-ready on a global stage.
goals.imageAlt: Students gaining practical international agricultural experience

items.title: International Internships
items.text: Tailored programmes in Denmark, Germany, the USA, Israel, and Australia — covering dairy farming, crop production, and agribusiness management with hands-on exposure to modern techniques.

items.title: Agri Professional Development Program
items.text: A one-year abroad internship and training programme for agriculture students, building skills in sustainable agriculture, precision farming, and agribusiness management.

items.title: Farmer Technology Projects
items.text: Introducing precision agriculture, drone monitoring, and mobile apps for weather and market prices — helping farmers make data-driven decisions to increase yields and reduce costs.

items.title: Agri-Entrepreneur Development
items.text: Seminars and special programmes encouraging new entrepreneurs in the agricultural sector, connecting students and farmers with global technologies and professionals.

cta.description: Join over 100 agriculture students who have built world-class careers through GreenRoot's international internship and training programmes.
